player_allow_vrr_hint: A variable-refresh display follows the stream's frame rate, for smoother motion.

player_keep_awake_hint: Off, a stream keeps the screen awake only while you play.

player_show_advanced_hint: Adds the settings most players never need to change.
player_audio_channels_hint: The speaker layout requested from the host.
player_mic_enabled_hint: This device's microphone feeds the host's virtual mic.
player_mic_enabled_keys_hint: {keys} mutes and unmutes it while streaming.

player_echo_cancel_hint: Filters the stream's own audio out of the mic pickup.
player_spatial_audio_hint: On, the sound comes from the window. Off plays the game's own mix straight to your ears.
player_audio_route_hint: Offload lets the TV decode the audio itself, which saves CPU but is stereo only and not on every set.
player_touch_mode_hint: Trackpad moves the cursor, Direct pointer puts it under your finger, Touch passthrough sends raw touches.
player_mouse_mode_hint: Capture locks the pointer to the stream for mouse-look; Desktop leaves it free.
player_invert_scroll_hint: Reverses the wheel and trackpad scroll direction sent to the host.
player_inhibit_shortcuts_hint: Forward {keys} to the host while input is captured.
player_cursor_gestures_hint: Hold {button} for a right click, on a remote with no second button; off, {button} is a plain left click.
player_gamepad_hint: The virtual controller the host creates — Automatic matches yours.
player_pad_rumble_hint: Off, controllers don't vibrate from the stream or in the menus, whatever the game sends.
player_rumble_on_phone_hint: Also play controller 1's rumble on this device's motor.
player_gyro_on_phone_hint: Sends this device's motion as player 1's when the controller has no gyro.
player_gamepad_forwarding_hint: Sends this device's controllers to the host; turn it off if they already reach it another way.

player_system_buttons_hint: Where guide and share presses go while streaming.
player_guide_gesture_hint: Hold {button} alone for the host's guide button — a tap still goes through.
player_pad_haptics_hint: Plays a DualSense's fine-grained haptics on the controller itself.
player_pad_speaker_hint: Plays the audio a game sends to the controller's speaker on the controller, not through this device.

player_ds_capture_hint: Drives a DualSense or DualShock on USB directly: rumble, adaptive triggers, lightbar and gyro.
